digest.component_or_area: repository-wide module size management and CI metrics
propositions: 46 Python files in src/rebar exceed 700 LOC with 7 files at/near the 800-LOC hard cap; pass1.py and push.py are each 800 LOC and must be split to reduce recurrence.

Module-size leading indicator (module_size_distribution.near_cap_count = 37 files within 10% of cap) exists but is invisible to CI; must emit non-blocking warnings in the Module-size gate to surface headroom issues before contributors hit the hard-cap failure.

Extracting container-stage responsibilities from pass1.py (300 LOC) requires moving _submit_ctx to generation.py to preserve ContextVar ownership and avoid cycles; direction pass1→container_stage→generation must stay one-way.

Extracting push-recovery cluster from push.py (345 LOC) requires late-binding core-parameter pattern (not module import) because ~25 test sites monkeypatch push._git, and 8 of the 9 moved functions call it; binding pre-patch would silently run real git during test assertions.
